text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "I wanted to touch it and see for myself."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Mm... The surface is smooth too. The color 
is lovely, and—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The carving of the word "hard" looks great 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's a deep engraving, so laser... or 
perhaps... no.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I really do want to learn how it's made, 
too...
